title: Graph Decompositions at the Expectation Threshold
summary: For \(n\ge3\) and a graph \(H\) on at most \(n\) vertices, let \(q(H)\) be the expectation threshold for its containment in \(G(n,p)\). We prove that there are absolute constants \(a,L>0\) such that, for every \(C>0\), every graph of degeneracy at most \(C\log n/\log\log n\) has a deterministic edge decomposition into at most \(\lceil a(C+1)\rceil\) pieces, each with ordinary containment threshold at most \(Lq(H)\).
